ashley (Sales): FYI Vertex Labs just dropped a SIG + a short custom security questionnaire. They want answers by Fri EOD. Can security pick this up? Link to files: https://drive.redwood/vertex/sig.zip :grimacing:

devon (Security): @ashley I can own the SIG intake. Two quick asks: 1) can you upload the filled spreadsheet/CSV version (helps for bulk mapping), 2) confirm whether PII will be in scope and which deployment they're evaluating (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).

ashley (Sales): Uploading now — here's the spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/vertex/sig-answers.xlsx. They plan to run POC on Dedicated, prod on Hosted. PII: only email + hashed IDs for the POC, production may include user profile info. They specifically ask about KMS/HSM and SOC2.

ryan (Sales Eng): Heads-up — they've asked for a sample data flow diagram and end-to-end encryption details. We have a DFD template at https://internal/docs/sec-templates/dfd if it helps.

devon (Security): Good. I'm assigning to myself for triage. I'll start mapping SIG -> CAIQ and flag any control gaps. Debbie — can you pull SOC2 report and any control evidence (S3/KMS configs, CloudTrail examples)?

debbie (Solutions): On it. I can attach SOC2 cert and example CloudTrail logs tomorrow AM. ETA: tomorrow noon.

devon (Security): Plan: complete draft SIG answers by Thu, identify Qs needing product input (encryption key custody, multi-tenant separation), then hand off crypto-specific items to SecEng. If they ask for an ATO timeline, propose dedicated-residency workaround as interim.

ashley (Sales): Please keep me in the loop. Customer is asking if sign-off could be within 2 weeks if no major gaps.

sec-bot: New task created: SEC-4721 — Vertex Labs SIG intake. Owner: devon. Due: 2024-07-18. https://tickets.redwood/SEC-4721

devon (Security): Quick clarifying Q: any downstream sub-processors or vendors in the POC? cc @ryan

ryan (Sales Eng): No external sub-processors beyond our cloud provider. I'll confirm the exact KMS provider and key custody model and post here.

devon (Security): Perfect. Marking evidence-needed questions: `SIG:3.1, SIG:4.2 (key custody), CAIQ:enc-2`. Using internal template `sig-answer-v2.md` for consistency. If anyone has canned language for KMS/HSM we should paste it here.

debbie (Solutions): Pasting standard blurb for KMS/S3: `All customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 using customer-specific keys managed via AWS KMS. Customer-managed CMKs can be used for Dedicated/Private deployments; keys are HSM-backed and access is logged via CloudTrail.`

devon (Security): That works — I'll slot it into the SIG and add references to the SOC2 report where relevant. I'll also call out any items that need engineering evidence (config snippets). :thumbsup:

ashley (Sales): Thanks team! I'll notify Vertex that security is working it and we should have a first pass by Thursday. :tada:
